scores.label: A
scores.note: option 4 'anxious' describes a person, not the situation 'it', so it is wrong in place; options 5 'aggravating' and 6 'annoying' change stress into irritation; the rest are plain near-synonyms or drift (exhausting, overwhelming overstates)

scores.label: B
scores.note: demanding and trying are strong; arduous and strenuous lean toward physical effort; the rest are plain; option 10 failed as a duplicate

scores.label: C
scores.note: option 10 'pressing' is the wrong sense (urgent); tense, demanding and trying are strong; overwhelming overstates slightly
